images.title: 식당 공간과 자리 소품
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the supplied flat planning diagram into one full-frame 3D game environment reference image for a four-person Unity project, a cozy dungeon stair-landing restaurant. Preserve the functional relationships (arrival stair, dining area, kitchen counter, descending dungeon stair, walking paths) but completely replace its 2D diagram appearance with a tangible stylized low-poly 3D scene. Wide landscape 16:10 composition, clear elevated three-quarter orthographic game camera, cutaway stone walls. A modest compact stone-and-wood restaurant tucked into a broad stair landing. Visible entry stairs from above at the left and a clearly distinct stair descending into a softly lit dungeon on the right. A small kitchen counter at the back with a steaming pot and serving dishes. Several dining places visibly adjacent to a hearth, a potted herb, a softly glowing decorative crystal, a cushioned bench, a simple wooden partition, and an airy window opening; these are possible props, not a finalized asset list. Keep the room easy to navigate, not cluttered. One generic adult owner in a plain apron seen mostly from behind carries a plate, two adult fantasy adventurers calmly dine. Characters must be simple, provisional 3D miniatures, not detailed hero designs. Warm welcoming light in the restaurant, cool blue-green ambient stone dungeon. Rounded readable forms, matte hand-painted materials, restrained geometry feasible for a small indie game, consistent physically grounded 3D lighting and depth. This is a playable spatial concept, not cinematic splash art. No written words at all, no title, no labels, no UI cards, no dialogue bubbles, no buttons, no numerical stats, no colored HUD rings, no arrows, no blueprint grid, no watermark. Show environmental effects with local light, hearth warmth and foliage. One continuous scene, not panels.

images.title: 손님 외형 관찰
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transform the supplied 2D conversation wireframe into a new full-frame 3D spatial gameplay concept for a cozy dungeon stair-landing restaurant. Retain its idea of reading a guest's condition and equipment, but remove every UI element and all text. Wide landscape 16:10. Elevated three-quarter game camera somewhat closer to a guest by the restaurant entrance. A single adult elf adventurer with clearly readable long ears, simple travel cloak and staff, lightly scorched boot toes, a tired shoulder posture and a hand wiping their brow; subtle warm dust on clothing. These are observable travel clues, not a fight. A generic adult owner in plain apron, mostly back/side view, listens with an attentive welcoming gesture. Both full bodies and their silhouettes should be visible with ample separation. Behind them, a compact stone-and-wood restaurant: hearth, herb pot beside a table, kitchen counter with dishes, two different stair paths suggesting arrival and descent. Use physical wardrobe/props/body posture as clues rather than floating status markers. Rounded, stylized low-poly 3D miniatures with matte hand-painted materials, restrained detail practical for a small Unity indie project. Warm hearth lighting against soft cool dungeon stone, friendly and thoughtful mood. Camera and lighting should read as actual 3D game reference, not a 2D illustration or UI mockup. Character designs are generic concept suggestions, not final canon. No text, no signs, no overlay interface, no cards, no speech bubbles, no UI border, no numerical labels, no icons, no arrows, no watermark. One continuous scene, not panels.

images.title: 재료 투입과 자동 조리
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transform this flat kitchen UI wireframe into one full-frame 3D game scene reference for a cozy dungeon stair-landing restaurant. Keep the idea of choosing ingredients and seasonings and letting cooking finish automatically, but remove the interface completely. Wide landscape 16:10 elevated three-quarter orthographic game camera, compact stone-and-wood kitchen counter in the foreground, dining area visible behind. A wooden preparation board with potato and herbs, small unlabelled seasoning jars, a lidded iron pot steaming gently on a stove, a pan and small masonry oven as optional tool concepts, and one completed bowl on a pickup ledge. A generic adult owner wearing a simple apron has already stepped away from the active pot and is carrying a finished dish toward an adult adventurer at a nearby table: cooking continues unattended, no chopping action or timing minigame. Arrange ingredient station, heat sources and serving ledge clearly to communicate workflow spatially. Readable modest props, accessible walking route, no crowded luxury kitchen. Rounded stylized low-poly 3D geometry, matte hand-painted wood and stone materials, soft physically grounded lighting, warm hearth glow with cool ambient dungeon stone. A feasible small-team Unity game concept, not cinematic splash art. No text or price tags anywhere, no recipe cards, no menus, no buttons, no numerical stats, no floating icons, no UI panels, no progress bars, no arrows, no watermark. One scene, not a sequence of panels.

images.title: 다음 날 귀환과 재료 전달
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Replace the supplied flat results-screen wireframe with a full-frame 3D spatial game scene showing next-morning guest return in a cozy dungeon stair-landing restaurant. Preserve its meaning (guest safely returns, brings dungeon ingredients, their visible condition conveys the outcome) using bodies and props rather than a UI. Wide landscape 16:10 elevated three-quarter game camera. In a modest stone-and-wood restaurant on a dungeon stair landing, an adult human adventurer emerges from a clearly descending dungeon stair and warmly presents a small woven basket of unusual mushrooms and red fantasy peppers to the generic adult restaurant owner wearing a simple apron. Another adult guest rests on a cushioned bench with a small clean bandage on the forearm and a tired but comfortable posture, gently indicating a difficult journey without suffering. Owner greets them attentively; the scene conveys relationship and relief. A plain open notebook with no legible writing rests on a wooden counter, beside an ingredient basket, suggesting accumulated knowledge. Warm morning light from an upper stair opening, subtle cool depth down the dungeon stair. Simple rounded low-poly 3D figures, matte hand-painted materials, restrained props and readable silhouettes, cozy grounded small-indie-game art direction matching the other scene concepts. No combat, no blood. No text, no grade stamps, no score panel, no cards, no dialogue bubbles, no buttons, no UI overlays, no floating icons, no numerical counters, no arrows, no watermark. One continuous spatial scene.
